requests.ask: For the first useful product, is the priority discovering neighborhoods or comparing known buildings? Is the morning commute enough, or is the return journey needed too?
requests.impact: These choices refine the completed vision draft and next scope. No implementation is underway; the earlier patch proposal remains deferred.
requests.recommendation: Noa recommends a place shortlist supported by a map; a neighborhood-first direction is the alternative. Reply to the questions already presented by dot in Slack.

cards.title: Demonstrate bicycle feasibility
cards.summary: USGS DEM graph and four directional landmark pairs checked; 50 bike samples returned 11 qualifying and 39 bounded negatives.
cards.done_when: Documented elevation source, bike/walk-only legs and independent uphill/downhill checks support the bounded experiment.
cards.next_step: Keep profile gaps and rider calibration as follow-up work; no full-area or field-validation claim.

cards.title: Strengthen routing evidence
cards.summary: Expand representative origins and boundary cases before making coverage claims.
cards.done_when: Named and snapped origins, transfer/calendar edge cases, errors and cold timing are documented.
cards.next_step: Replace synthetic samples with representative origins and inspect returned legs.

cards.title: Build the usable SLC commute map
cards.summary: Local map cycle complete; UT-01 feedback received. Confirmed qualifying TRAX alternative omitted by combined search; alternatives presentation needs clarity.
cards.owner: Parent: goal/priorities · technical lead: breakdown · independent reviewer
cards.done_when: A usable local map makes sampling and uncertainty explicit; Martijn can inspect familiar locations and their exact-origin itineraries.
cards.next_step: Patch proposal deferred, not awaiting approval. Use UT-01 and routing evidence to inform Noa’s longer-term product vision before implementation.

cards.title: Local routing foundation
cards.summary: Local Git, OTP 2.10.0 and mise Java 25 are working; inputs and outputs stay local.
cards.done_when: A reproducible local graph build and query harness are documented.
cards.next_step: Keep provenance and reproduction steps current.

cards.title: Run the transit feasibility spike
cards.summary: 450 queries across nine scenarios; 2,070 timetable comparisons with zero mismatches.
cards.done_when: Bus/TRAX/both × 0/1/2 changes inspected across 50 sampled origins; 13 tests passing.
cards.next_step: Broaden validation; these are schedule estimates, not exhaustive reachability.

cards.title: Verify the ART approach
cards.summary: Official southwest entrance and mapped final walking approach checked.
cards.done_when: University entrance evidence and decoded route geometry agree near the ART door.
cards.next_step: Retain ordinary-walking limitation; no wheelchair or field-validation claim.

cards.title: Historical service reliability
cards.summary: No collector enabled and no validated reliability values.
cards.done_when: Historical events, matching feeds, coverage and sample sizes support defensible metrics.
cards.next_step: Revisit collection scope and data rights before any implementation.

cards.title: Broader geographic coverage
cards.summary: The buffered SLC crop is not a full UTA accessibility model.
cards.done_when: A separately scoped regional model has validated inputs and measured performance.
cards.next_step: Use the initial SLC experiment to size a later expansion.

cards.title: Calibrate bike estimates
cards.summary: Library has an 84.53 m missing profile; graph profile failures and upstream aggregate elevation remain unresolved.
cards.done_when: Profile gaps are explained or repaired and estimates have independent empirical calibration.
cards.next_step: Investigate profile failures; retain unknown classification and omit untrusted aggregate totals.

cards.title: Define product vision and design direction
cards.summary: Noa completed docs/product-vision.md: place shortlist supported by a map, with a neighborhood-first alternative. Draft delivered; product choices pending.
cards.owner: Noa · product/design lead; dot coordinates; Martijn owns product decisions
cards.done_when: A coherent product/design direction is documented for Martijn’s review, grounded in UT-01 and explicit technical constraints.
cards.next_step: Await Martijn’s answers to the two questions already presented in Slack: neighborhoods vs known buildings; morning-only vs return journey. No implementation underway; patch deferred.

technical_constraints.title: Bicycle model limits
technical_constraints.detail: The bounded bike spike is complete. Missing profiles and rider calibration remain team follow-up work, with no user action blocking local development.

technical_constraints.title: Publication boundary
technical_constraints.detail: UTA reuse/redistribution terms remain unresolved. This does not block authorized local work; publication is outside current scope.
